description: This file defines an abstract class 'TemporalExpression' used for representing and evaluating temporal expressions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for date range calculation, comparison, and substitution logic, serving as a base for concrete temporal expression implementations.

classes.name: TemporalExpression
classes.description: An abstract class representing a temporal expression with methods for evaluation, comparison, and range calculation.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for the temporal expression.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this expression with another based on sequence.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on id and sequence.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on id and sequence.

methods.name: getSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number used for sorting.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the expression.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique ID of the expression.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first occurrence date on or after a given date.

methods.name: includesDate
methods.description: Checks if a date is included in the expression.

methods.name: isSubstitutionCandidate
methods.description: Determines if the expression could produce a given date based on substitution logic.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next occurrence date after a given date.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns a set of dates within a range that match the expression.
